reviewer: Claude（Claude Code 会话）：faster-whisper small.en 与 medium.en 两档逐词转写交叉核对，并对照本地抽帧；未人工听音

foreground_english.en: I want to talk about you guys.
I know, earlier in the tournament I said something kind of in a bad way.
foreground_english.zh: 我知道，之前我说话不太好听。

foreground_english.en: Now I'm saying it in a good way:
foreground_english.zh: 现在我换个好听的说法：

foreground_english.en: because of your energy, guys, I was here in the final.
foreground_english.zh: 是你们的能量把我送进了决赛。

review_note: 梅德韦杰夫颁奖致辞原声，两档逐词一致（small 129.38–141.14、medium 129.26–141.14）。段首 128.6 在上一句 didn't go my way and I（128.5 前后）之后。
